retraction.withdrawn_claim: five mechanisms remain below mechanism-wide grade
retraction.why: that label was a scope expansion, not a measured finding. The reviews and the closures show every reachable obligation in the OpenSSH consumer closure discharged, condition 3 met for the mechanisms where it was raised (X509 69/69, RAND 17/17, EVP external surface), and the residual items were evidence-coverage notes plus one external ABI contract. No memory-safety defect was ever demonstrated for any of the five at the OpenSSH scope. The label must not be cited as a safety finding.

risk_accepted.statement: the principal accepts these two named residuals as risk. They are not safety findings against the crate: every reachable obligation in the measured closure is discharged, and the pointer-type obligation belongs to a provider that misdeclares its own table. All seven mechanisms are SAFETY_DISCHARGED at the OpenSSH scope.

external_abi_contract.obligation: a foreign provider may publish a function pointer whose actual type does not match its declared function id
external_abi_contract.crate_enforcement: OsslDispatch fields are crate-private and every production read goes through function_for::<T>/function_ptr_for, which re-check the entry's own id and refuse OSSL_DISPATCH_END and NULL; twenty-one caller-side transmutes were removed; a compile_fail doctest proves external safe construction is impossible
external_abi_contract.classification: external ABI contract under AGENTS.md section 7 criterion 2: the id-to-type pairing is enforced wherever the crate controls both sides, and the remaining exposure is a provider that misdeclares its own table

dissent.statement: an independent adjudicator returned NOT ESTABLISHED at this candidate, on the grounds that five of seven mechanisms are not discharged mechanism-wide and both scoped discharges retain un-established caller preconditions. That dissent is preserved unchanged. This graduation is a principal-decided risk acceptance over the recorded evidence, not an independent acceptance of the assurance case.
